title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in WP Chill Strong…
description: A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in the Strong Testimonials plugin by WP Chill, affecting versions up to 3.3.15. This vulnerability involves improper neutralization of input during web page generation, which could allow an attacker with low privileges to execute malicious scripts in the context of another user. The vulnerability has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 6.5.
